name: Southern Uprising

tenures.source: The promotion's own house-show cards of 5 May and 29 May 2001.

caption: Won a tag match over the Monsters of the Midwest on 5 May 2001, then won the Smokey Mountain Tag Team Championship from the champions on 29 May 2001 as last-minute replacement challengers.

name: Monsters of the Midwest

tenures.source: The promotion's own house-show card of 5 May 2001.

caption: Lost a tag match to Southern Uprising on 5 May 2001 after a miscommunication between the two partners.

name: Girlz on Film

tenures.source: The promotion's own house-show cards of 5 May and 29 May 2001.

caption: Held the Smokey Mountain Tag Team Championship into 29 May 2001, when Southern Uprising took the titles.
notes: Named repeatedly as a wider alliance on both cards; only the two title-holding members are confirmed here.

identity.note: A same-named tag team is on record in a wholly different promotion five years later, with different members; no document ties the two together, so the records stay apart.
